extracted.intended_audience: registered patent practitioners, petitioners seeking reinstatement before the USPTO, and USPTO discipline office staff
extracted.subtask_description: Procedure and standards applied by the USPTO Office of Enrollment and Discipline when considering a petition for reinstatement of a suspended patent practitioner, including required filings and scope limits for non-attorney registrants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Affidavit certifying compliance with 37 CFR § 11.58
rubrics_metrics.description: On January 15, 2010, Mr. Basrai filed an Affidavit certifying compliance with the requirements of 37 CFR § 11.58.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Filing an affidavit certifying compliance with the conditions set forth in 37 C.F.R. § 11.58 is a prerequisite considered in reinstatement petitions; the affidavit is part of the record the Office reviews when determining whether reinstatement is appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petition for Reinstatement review by Director
rubrics_metrics.description: Consideration has been given to the Petition for Reinstatement of Mr. Basrai that the Office of Enrollment and Discipline received on November 1, 2012. After careful review of the Petition for Reinstatement and Affidavit, the Director of Enrollment and Discipline has determined that reinstatement ... is appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Director (Office of Enrollment and Discipline) reviews the petition and accompanying affidavit and makes a determination whether reinstatement to practice before the USPTO is appropriate; substantive reasons for grant/denial may be reflected in the Director's review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope limitation for non-attorney registrants
rubrics_metrics.description: Mr. Basrai is not an attorney and, thus, is not authorized to practice before the Office in trademark and non-patent matters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Even if reinstated to practice patent law before the USPTO, non-attorneys remain limited in their authorization and are not permitted to practice trademark and non-patent matters before the Office.

rubrics_metrics.name: Effect of prior suspension terms
rubrics_metrics.description: In a Final Order dated October 31, 2012, Hunaid Basrai (Registration No. 53,973) was suspended nunc pro tunc from October 26, 2009, for a period of sixty (60) months from the practice of patent, trademark, and non-patent law before the USPTO and the last twenty-four (24) months of the suspension was stayed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reinstatement determinations take into account the terms of any prior suspension (duration, nunc pro tunc dates, and any portion stayed); petitioners must demonstrate compliance with those terms as part of the reinstatement process.
